session_summary: Completed Moon Shrine route (12 steps, 3 Slime encounters, coin collection totaling 126 coins) and purchased the Trail Cap cosmetic item for 45 coins. From an accessibility and UI standpoint, the flow was clean and readable, but keyboard focus rings and high-contrast styling still need attention per the backlog.

observations.evidence: Backlog item 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' indicates marketplace navigation and UI elements lack clear keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus rings and visible keyboard selection indicators across all menus and the marketplace.

observations.evidence: Market purchase feedback successfully displayed item name, price, and updated coin balance (126 coins).
observations.recommendation: Maintain clear transaction summary feedback like the current marketplace purchase confirmation message.

feature_requests.title: Keyboard Navigation Shortcuts for Marketplace & Inventory
feature_requests.player_value: Enables keyboard-only players to quickly jump between tabs, inspect items, and complete purchases without heavy mouse reliance.
feature_requests.rationale: Improves overall keyboard usability and reduces input friction during shopping sessions.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add hotkey indicators and direct keyboard mapping for common marketplace and menu actions.

keep: Clear, informative feedback messages upon completing route actions and marketplace purchases.
Straightforward step-by-step trace progression that keeps cognitive load manageable.
focus: readability, button clarity, cognitive load, feedback, keyboard/mouse usability
